## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`) — n = +1.2 → +3.2×10¹², B 0.4 → 10 T

> **05:28** · landau-fan-vti e-side D=0: n +1.2->+3.2e12 (51 pts, dn 0.04) fast paired (Vtg 0.41->0.98, Vbg 0.42->1.17 V); B 0.4->10 T slow, 241 rows uniform-1/B (0.4-1 T d(1/B) 0.025; 1-10 T d(1/B) 0.005); sr1 50 uV; fast\_delay 1.2 s; ends at 10 T, gates parked · **ETA ~12:13** (≈6h45m)

**Why the electron side (spot-check read, runs 6/7, from the TSVs):** run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T) carries a stable two-tone set — **7.3 T** (alive down to the 10 mT leg's edge at 1.0 T) and **29.4 T** (dominant, onset ≈ 1.8 T), stable across FFT cutoffs 1.5–5 T; 15/22 T are the light tone's 2×/3× comb, 59/88/120/150 T the heavy tone's harmonics (QH-like sharpening at high B), and a **≈ 37 T feature ≈ 7.3 + 29.4** is present natively — the breakdown sum-tone the investigation flags as *expected* for ABAB. Sum 36.7 T = 1.11·F_L (inside the lever-arm prior); partition 0.80/0.20 vs the model's ABAB 0.78/0.22 at this density. Run 7 (n = −1.2×10¹², the hole side's TG-limited reach) is the predicted near-CNP regime: peaks wander with the cutoff (7.8/2.2 → 5.0/12.5 → 12.8 T) — uninformative for the count. **Coverage trade:** the hole side is excluded from the fan; its D = 0 line reaches only n = −1.27×10¹² (TG −0.3 V), inside the low-|n| exception regime where the templates don't separate, so full coverage would buy ~2 h of resolution-limited columns. The fan follows the cleaner side, as the investigation prescribes.

**What the fan decides:** F(n) of both tones across n = 1.2 → 3.2. Model (ABAB, this density window): heavy/F_L runs 0.78 → 0.91 as n falls, light branch 7.3 → 1.2 T (empties toward n ≈ 0.8) — vs ABCA a single tone at F_L throughout, vs ABCB a light Dirac-shaped partner. Tests: f₁(n) + f₂(n) = s·F_L(n) with one global scale s (Luttinger, algebraic); dual Onsager overlay (ABAB vs trilayer curves); the 37 T tone's B-window behaviour (breakdown | pocket); n = 3.2 column cross-checks run 6 directly.

**Design (investigation Step 2 + `landau-fan` step 1, computed):** B_lo: `sdh_onset` on run 6's 10 mT leg gives the light tone *censored at 1.0 T* (lower bound), heavy tone 1.8 T. Rather than a separate low-field extension, the fan carries a **low leg 0.4 → 1.0 T at Δ(1/B) = 0.025** (60 rows, Nyquist 20 T — light tone + its 2× only; the heavy tone is dead there): it pins the light-tone onset per column and extends the light-branch track from n ≳ 2.0 (≥ 3 periods at B_lo = 1) down to n ≈ 1.5 (≥ 5 periods at B_lo = 0.4). Price of that leg ≈ 1 h 20 m. **Main leg 1.0 → 10 T at Δ(1/B) = 0.005** (181 rows, Nyquist 100 T). This is finer than the F_L Nyquist-3 floor (0.0088) on purpose: run 6 resampled onto candidate grids shows that at 0.0083 the heavy tone's 3rd harmonic (88 T, SNR 52) folds to **32 T — onto F_L**, which would fake exactly the singleton the origin check has to exclude; at 0.005 every harmonic through 5× folds outside 0–45 T. δF at the top: 1/(1/1.8 − 0.1) = 2.2 T (heavy vs ABCA split 7.5 T at n = 3.2, 3.6 T at n = 2.0). n-axis: 51 points, Δn = 0.04×10¹² = 2.4 per 4-fold ray at 1 T (the 2D ray-pattern read floors at B ≥ 1 T; below that the low leg is per-column-FFT-only). Dwell 1.2 s = 4τ (B is the slow axis, settled through the blocking ramp; the fast-axis lag is a common ≲ 1-column n-shift, not a tone attenuation). Sensitivity 50 µV = 5 kΩ FS, fixed: worst corner low-n × 10 T — run 7 at n = −1.2 (closer to the CNP than any fan column) peaked at 587 Ω = 0.12 FS; run 6 resolved SdH at 0.2–1 % FS from 1 T at the same setting.

**Price:** 241 rows × (51 × 1.3 s/pt + 7 s turnaround) ≈ 4 h 55 m (per-point from run 5: 1.10 s at fast_delay 1.0 → 1.3 s at 1.2) + 0 → 10 T measured traverse ≈ 1 h 25 m (run 6: 3.1 s set-call overhead per row on top of the 73 min bare ramp) → ≈ 6 h 20 m; headline with the session's +5–10 % rule **≈ 6 h 45 m**. Ends at **10 T, gates parked at 0 V** — the next step (LK mass split / origin check) rides the magnet down. Preconditions printed above the sweep: T_sample 1.0–1.5 K, |B| < 0.05 T (magnet returned to 0 at the handoff), V_si = 0, PS heater + output on, nplci 1/1, sr1 τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB.

**Checkpoints (hera-watch, armed on this run):** (1) *first rows* (0.4–0.5 T): sr1 signal/no rail, leakage < 1 nA excluding the flyback transient, field readback tracking, row time vs the 73 s budget. (2) *~1.5 T* (end of the low leg, ~1.5 h in): per-column FFT on the landed rows — light tone present in the high-n columns; re-price. (3) *~4 T and ~7 T*: partial per-column FFT — heavy tone present and tracking n; worst-column `fs` (rail watch — any column ≥ 0.9 FS → interrupt and decide). Wash-out: no tone in any column by 4 T (not expected given run 6).

# === Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`): n = +1.2 -> +3.2e12 (51 pts, fast paired n-line) x B 0.4 -> 10 T (241 rows, uniform-1/B in two legs, slow) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = 9.5 nm geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_lo, n_hi, N_n = 1.2, 3.2, 51        # 1e12 cm^-2; dn = 0.04e12 = 2.4 pts per 4-fold LL ray at 1 T (ray-pattern read floors at B >= 1 T)
D0 = 0.0                              # V/nm — the investigation's operating point
ns = np.linspace(n_lo, n_hi, N_n); Ds = np.full(N_n, D0)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs, float), np.asarray(Vbgs, float)
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
n_chk, D_chk = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
print(f"n-line: n = {n_lo:+.2f} -> {n_hi:+.2f}e12 ({N_n} pts, dn = {ns[1]-ns[0]:.3f}e12) at D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm; "
      f"Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V; "
      f"roundtrip n [{np.min(n_chk):+.3f}, {np.max(n_chk):+.3f}], max|D| {np.max(np.abs(D_chk)):.4f}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05: fan starts from 0 -> 0.4 T), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"sr1 tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB (0.3 / 24 -> dwell 1.2 s = 4 tau)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"
assert sr1.time_constant() == 0.3 and sr1.filter_slope() == 24, "sr1 tau/slope changed — dwell sized for 0.3 s / 24 dB"

# --- slow axis: uniform in 1/B, two legs (both from the run-6 spot check).
#     Low leg 0.4 -> 1.0 T, d(1/B) = 0.025 (Nyquist 20 T: the light tone and its 2x only — the heavy tone is below its ~1.8 T onset here).
#     Main leg 1.0 -> 10 T, d(1/B) = 0.005 (Nyquist 100 T: heavy tone ~30 T; its 2x/3x/4x/5x harmonics at 59/88/120/150 T fold to
#     59/88/80/50 T — none into the 0-45 T claim band. At d(1/B) = 0.0083 the 3x would fold onto F_L = 33 T; checked on run 6 resampled.)
B_low = field_invB(0.4, 1.0, 61)[:-1]
B_main = field_invB(1.0, 10.0, 181)
B_vec = np.round(np.hstack((B_low, B_main)), 5)
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.2, 3.0     # 4 tau at tau = 0.3 s; B is the slow axis, so each row settles through the blocking ramp + 3 s driver settle + SLOW_DELAY
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Worst corner is low-n x 10 T: run 7 (n = -1.2e12, closer to the CNP
# than any fan column) peaked at 587 Ohm = 0.12 FS at 10 T; run 6 (n = +3.2e12) resolved SdH at 0.2-1 % FS from 1 T. 8x headroom, same setting as both spot checks.
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} rows, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T (legs: {len(B_low)} rows @ d(1/B) = 0.025, {len(B_main)} rows @ 0.005); "
      f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V, drive {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency()} Hz")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron side, D = 0: n {n_lo:+.2f} -> {n_hi:+.2f}e12 ({N_n} pts) fast paired (Vtg, Vbg); "
                  f"B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T slow, {len(B_vec)} rows uniform-1/B (0.4-1 T d(1/B) 0.025; 1-10 T d(1/B) 0.005); "
                  f"run-5 cal; sr1 50 uV; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm, n = {n_lo:+.2f} to {n_hi:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 ({N_n} pts, electron side), '
              f'B = {B_vec[0]} to {B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_vec)} rows, uniform-1/B: 0.4-1 T d(1/B) = 0.025, 1-10 T d(1/B) = 0.005); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e} F/m2, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'inherits sdh-spot-check run 6 (light 7.3 T tone alive at 1 T, heavy 29.4 T tone onset ~1.8 T; sum tone ~37 T)')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B (slow), Vtg, Vbg (fast pair), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B = {float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg = {float(data[2]):+.4f} V: |I_tg| = {i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg| = {i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)   # park gates; the field stays where the fan ended (10 T) — the next step decides the ride-down
    print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
